metadata.restatement_note: Restatement 2026-11-17 (Audit §77.15 items 1-6): supersedes the §76.16 items 1-6 restatement recorded above, the 1.1.5 restatement recorded under Audit §75.10 items 3-4, the 1.1.4 restatement recorded under §74.10 Ruling D, the 1.1.3 one under §73.9 items 3-4, the 1.1.2 one under §72 N-128, the 1.1.1 one under §68.6 item 3 (H-115), and the 2026-11-14T16:45:00+00:00 artifact before those. Criteria version 1.1.7 changes no existing numeric PASS/FAIL threshold. It (i) adds CRIT-OVERFIT-05, min_liquidated_pf_ex_top_1 = 1.40, so a liquidated PF that needs its single largest winner to clear 1.50 is a FAIL rather than a sentence beside the row (§77.12 item 4); and (ii) re-points CRIT-OVERFIT-03 at the anchored expanding in-sample folds — four partitions of one run's own ledger ending 2022-06-30, 2022-12-30, 2023-06-30 and 2023-12-29, gated by min_positive_is_fold_ratio = 0.75 and min_fold_liquidated_pf = 1.30 — with the previous validation-fold definition moving unchanged to CRIT-OVERFIT-06, so min_positive_walk_forward_fold_ratio = 0.80 stays enforced (§77.13). Both new rows are NOT RUN on this Tier-A bundle, which carries no trade ledger to partition. This artifact also stops reporting an archive-wide bhavcopy resolution under CRIT-DATA-05's key: that statistic now travels as archive_traded_eq_resolution_pct, because CRIT-DATA-05 is the evaluation window's traded-row measure and the two denominators are not interchangeable (§77.15 item 2, N-146). Under 1.1.6 it (i) excluded expected_trial_registry_manifest_sha256 from the criteria fingerprint, so appending a trial and re-pinning the manifest no longer invalidates the anchor a verdict cites, while the pin stays mandatory in the loader and is still enforced by Gate G2A-6.8a (N-139); (ii) gates min_haircut_sharpe_ratio = 1.25 as CRIT-OVERFIT-04 instead of leaving a committed threshold unenforced (N-141); (iii) evaluates CRIT-STAT-01 and CRIT-STAT-02 on the liquidated book, with the closed-only pair and the PF sensitivity to the largest winners retained as disclosures on the same rows (Ruling 1); (iv) evaluates CRIT-STAT-03 at trade entry, as its own definition says, with the hold-period maximum reported and not gated (Ruling 2); (v) wires CRIT-DATA-05 to the H-54 traded-row measure and adds CRIT-DATA-07 dataset completeness at 100.0%, so 196 / 211 = 92.8910% fails closed until the 15 unresolved instruments are accounted for (Ruling 3, N-140); and (vi) attributes every ticket rejection by side and reason, so a refused SELL is visible (N-142). The trials manifest pin is unchanged at 3326b1b2... with N = 9, N_eval = 5, and no trial was appended or scored in this commit. Provenance remains CONTENT_IDENTIFIED_ONLY / SOURCE_UNVERIFIED, so CRIT-PROV-01 is still NOT RUN and every Tier-A verdict is unchanged.
